en: vt. to leave something out, either intentionally or by accident; to fail to do something
ex: Please don't omit any important details from your report.
請不要在報告中遺漏任何重要細節。

en: n. the way in which something works; a planned activity involving many people; a medical procedure in which a doctor cuts into the body; a mathematical process
ex: The operation took about three hours and was successful.
手術進行了大約三小時，很成功。

en: a. completely different; located on the other side; prep. in a position facing something; n. a person or thing that is completely different from another
ex: She lives in the house opposite ours.
她住在我們家對面的房子。

en: a. produced or grown without artificial chemicals; relating to living things; having parts that work together as a whole
ex: We only buy organic vegetables from the local farm.
我們只向當地農場購買有機蔬菜。

en: vt. to arrange or plan something so that it works well; to put things into a particular order; vi. to form a group or union
ex: We need to organize a farewell party for our manager.
我們得為經理籌備一場歡送會。

en: n. the open air; areas outside buildings, especially natural places; adv. outside a building, in the open air
ex: The children love playing outdoors on sunny days.
孩子們喜歡在晴天到戶外玩耍。

en: n. a general description or plan that gives only the main points; the line that shows the shape of something; vt. to describe the main features of something
ex: Please write an outline of your essay before you start.
開始寫之前，請先列出文章的大綱。

en: n. a closed box or space that is heated for cooking or baking food
ex: She took the bread out of the oven.
她把麵包從烤箱裡拿了出來。

en: a. located in or coming from another country across the sea; adv. in or to another country, especially one across the sea
ex: Many students go overseas to study English every year.
每年都有許多學生出國留學英文。

en: vt. to have to pay money back to someone; to feel that you should be grateful to someone for something; to have something because of someone or something
ex: I owe my parents a great deal for their support.
我欠父母很多，感謝他們的支持。

en: n. a bird with large eyes that hunts small animals at night and makes a low calling sound
ex: We heard an owl hooting in the forest at midnight.
我們在午夜聽見貓頭鷹在森林裡啼叫。

en: n. the fact of owning something; the legal right to own something
ex: The ownership of the building changed hands last year.
這棟大樓的所有權去年易主了。

en: n. a large animal like a cow that is used for pulling heavy loads, especially in the past
ex: The farmer used an ox to pull the plow.
農夫用一頭牛來拉犁。

en: n. a person who paints pictures as art; a person whose job is to paint walls, buildings, and other surfaces
ex: The painter is working on a portrait of the queen.
這位畫家正在畫女王的肖像。

en: n. a large, impressive house where a king, queen, or other important person lives; a very large, grand building
ex: The tourists took photos in front of the royal palace.
遊客們在皇宮前拍照。

en: n. a thin, flat, round cake made from batter and cooked in a pan, often eaten for breakfast
ex: We had pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
我們早餐吃了淋楓糖漿的煎餅。

en: n. a public celebration in which people, vehicles or bands move through the streets; v. to walk together in a formal way; to show something off in order to impress people
ex: Thousands of people watched the parade on New Year's Day.
新年當天，數千人觀賞了遊行。

en: n. a tropical bird with bright feathers that can copy human speech; a person who repeats what others say without thinking; vt. to repeat someone's words or actions without understanding them
ex: The parrot repeated everything we said.
那隻鸚鵡把我們說的每句話都重複了一遍。
ph: 鸚鵡學舌地重複某人的話

en: n. a long narrow space with walls on both sides, connecting rooms; a short part of a book or speech; the process of moving through a place or period of time
ex: The reading passage was too difficult for the beginners.
這篇閱讀短文對初學者來說太難了。

en: n. a person who travels in a vehicle, train, plane or ship but does not drive or operate it
ex: All the passengers were asked to fasten their seat belts.
所有乘客都被要求繫好安全帶。

en: n. an official document that shows who you are and allows you to travel to other countries; a means of getting something or being accepted
ex: Don't forget to bring your passport to the airport.
別忘了帶護照去機場。

en: n. a light touch with a flat hand; v. to touch someone or something gently and quickly with a flat hand; adv. perfectly or at exactly the right moment
ex: He gave the dog a friendly pat on the head.
他友善地拍了拍小狗的頭。

en: n. the ability to wait calmly or to accept trouble or annoyance without becoming angry
ex: Teaching young children requires a lot of patience.
教導幼兒需要很大的耐心。
ph: have the patience of a saint

en: vt. to cover a road, path or floor with a hard material such as concrete or stone; n. (pavement) a path for people to walk on beside a road
ex: The workers are paving the road with asphalt.
工人們正在用柏油鋪路。

en: n. a small round green seed that grows in a pod and is eaten as a vegetable
ex: She added some peas to the fried rice.
她在炒飯裡加了一些豌豆。
ph: like two peas in a pod

en: n. a hard, round, shiny white object formed inside an oyster and used in jewelry; something very valuable or excellent; vt. to decorate with pearls
ex: She wore a beautiful pearl necklace to the wedding.
她戴著一條漂亮的珍珠項鍊參加婚禮。

en: n. a black and white seabird that cannot fly and lives in the Antarctic and other cold areas
ex: The penguins slid across the ice on their bellies.
企鵝用肚皮在冰上滑行。
ph: 像企鵝一樣搖搖擺擺地走

en: n. a small coin of low value (one hundredth of a pound in the UK, or one cent in the US); a very small amount of money
ex: He didn't have a penny to his name.
他身無分文。
ph: turn up like a bad penny

en: vt. to do a piece of work or an action; to entertain people by singing, acting or playing music; vi. to work or function in a particular way
ex: The band will perform at the concert hall tonight.
樂團今晚將在音樂廳演出。

en: n. the act of performing a play, concert or other entertainment; how well someone or something does a job; the act of doing a task or duty
ex: The singer's live performance received a standing ovation.
那位歌手的現場演出獲得全場起立鼓掌。

en: vt. to make someone do or believe something by giving them good reasons; vi. to cause someone to be convinced
ex: I tried to persuade him to see a doctor.
我試著說服他去看醫生。

en: n. a person who takes photographs, especially as a job
ex: The wedding photographer took hundreds of pictures.
婚禮攝影師拍了數百張照片。

en: n. a fat gray bird with a small head that is common in cities; (informal) a person who is easily tricked
ex: Pigeons gather in the square to eat the bread crumbs.
鴿子聚集在廣場上啄食麵包屑。
ph: set the cat among the pigeons

en: n. a tall evergreen tree with thin, sharp leaves called needles; vi. to become thin and weak because of sadness or illness; to want something very much
ex: The mountain slope was covered with tall pine trees.
山坡上長滿了高大的松樹。

en: n. a unit of measurement for liquids or dry goods, equal to about 0.57 liters in the UK; a glass of beer containing this amount
ex: He ordered a pint of beer at the pub.
他在酒吧點了一品脫啤酒。

en: n. the level or degree of something; how high or low a musical sound is; the slope of a roof; a sales talk; v. to throw something; to set up a tent or camp; to fall or lean forward
ex: The singer was able to hit every note with perfect pitch.
那位歌手每個音都唱得音準完美。

en: a. full of fun and energy; intended as a joke and not to be taken seriously
ex: The puppy was in a playful mood this morning.
小狗今天早上興致高昂，一心想玩耍。

en: n. a round object used to block the hole in a bath or sink; a small device with metal pins that connects an electrical appliance to a power supply; vt. to fill a hole; to advertise something
ex: Please pull the plug out when you leave the room.
離開房間時請把插頭拔掉。

en: n. a long thin piece of wood or metal; either of the two points at the opposite ends of the Earth or a magnet; one of two opposite extremes; (Pole) a person from Poland
ex: Penguins live near the South Pole.
企鵝生活在靠近南極的地方。

en: a. connected with the work of government and the ideas of those who rule; relating to the beliefs or activities of political parties
ex: She is very interested in political issues.
她對政治議題很感興趣。
